generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural elements. A thick, dark green shape resembling the left side of a heart or a developing vine begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left. On the right side, completing the heart shape, is a stylized golden wheat stalk with several grains. Inside the heart shape are four stylized agricultural products, each a different color. The top element is a green apple oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the green apple is a yellow banana pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue avocado is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the blue avocado is a red plantain, oriented horizontally with its tip pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the blue avocado and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red plantain. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
